description: This is a Python source file defining the IngestService class, which manages data ingestion, file handling, and document listing for a private GPT application. It interacts with components like embedding, LLM, vector store, and node store, and handles ingestion of text, binary data, and bulk files.

classes.name: IngestService
classes.description: A singleton class responsible for ingesting data, managing ingestion workflows, and listing ingested documents within the private GPT system.

methods.name: __init__
methods.description: Initializes the IngestService with components for LLM, vector store, embedding, and node store, setting up storage context and ingestion component.

methods.name: _ingest_data
methods.description: Handles temporary file creation for data ingestion, supporting both bytes and text input, and calls ingest_file.

methods.name: ingest_file
methods.description: Ingests a file given its name and Path, returning a list of ingested documents.

methods.name: ingest_text
methods.description: Ingests text data as if it were a file, returning a list of ingested documents.

methods.name: ingest_bin_data
methods.description: Reads binary data from a file-like object and ingests it.

methods.name: bulk_ingest
methods.description: Performs bulk ingestion of multiple files, returning a list of ingested documents.

methods.name: list_ingested
methods.description: Lists all ingested documents by retrieving reference info from the document store.

methods.name: delete
methods.description: Deletes an ingested document by its ID from the storage.
